title: Candidates on the Campaign Trail
subtitle: Presidential hopefuls' agenda includes live streams and campaign events
excerpt: Presidential candidates are taking part in live streams and campaign events to engage voters.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The presidential hopefuls' agenda featured live streams, a podcast interview, and campaign events.

Campaign Activities

The candidates took part in a variety of activities to connect with voters and present their proposals.

  • Live streams: candidates used digital platforms to communicate directly with the electorate.
  • Podcast interview: some candidates appeared on podcasts to discuss their platforms.
  • Campaign events: candidates also attended rallies and other events to engage with voters.

These activities are part of the electoral calendar and are essential for candidates to introduce themselves and debate their proposals with the public.

With information from Agência Brasil.
